# Llamitas Spanish

> > Llamitas Spanish provides comprehensive Spanish curriculum, worksheets, and cultural resources for families raising bilingual children through thematic, age-appropriate lessons.

Created by Sandra Chu and featuring contributions from educators like Angela Gomez and Karla Ramirez, Llamitas Spanish offers products like the Preschool Spanish Morning Binder and Holiday and Seasonal Bundle. The site emphasizes bilingual education, biculturalism, and culturally-responsive language learning for children.

## Key Topics

- Spanish Curriculum
- Bilingual Education
- Preschool Spanish
- Kids Language Learning
- Spanish Worksheets
- Thematic Learning
- Biculturalism
- Family Language Plan
- Code-Switching
- Dual Language Immersion
- Spanish Lessons
- Cultural Education
- Heritage Language
- Language Practice

## Products & Curriculum

- [Products Archive](https://llamitasspanish.com/products): Main product catalog featuring Spanish curriculum and learning resources

## Bilingual Parenting & Education

- [What is Biculturalism?](https://llamitasspanish.com/biculturalism): Deep dive into biculturalism definition and raising bicultural kids in U.S.
- [Code-Switching: Is it Good or Bad?](https://llamitasspanish.com/code-switching): Exploring code-switching in bilingualism and raising bilingual children
- [Dual Language Schools in San Diego County](https://llamitasspanish.com/dual-language-schools-san-diego): Comprehensive list of free dual language immersion schools in San Diego

## Thematic Spanish Lessons

- [El bosque: Forest-themed Spanish lessons](https://llamitasspanish.com/forest-nature-spanish-lessons): Forest-themed Spanish lessons with nature vocabulary and outdoor activities
- [La Selva: Jungle Lessons in Spanish](https://llamitasspanish.com/spanish-jungle-themed-lessons): Jungle-themed Spanish lessons with Amazon rainforest vocabulary and activities
- [Spanish Lessons about Endangered and Extinct Animals](https://llamitasspanish.com/spanish-lessons-endangered-extinct-animals): Level 2 curriculum lessons on endangered/extinct animals with conservation focus

## Cultural Celebrations & Holidays

- [El día de los niños: Children's Day](https://llamitasspanish.com/dia-de-los-ninos): Guide to celebrating Children's Day (Día de los Niños) in Hispanic culture
- [Spanish Thanksgiving Worksheets](https://llamitasspanish.com/spanish-thanksgiving-worksheets): Thanksgiving-themed Spanish worksheets and Día de Acción de Gracias resources
- [Happy Birthday Lyrics in Spanish!](https://llamitasspanish.com/spanish-birthday-printables): Spanish birthday songs including Las Mañanitas and cumpleaños vocabulary

## Cultural Resources & Inspiration

- [15 Famous Latinas in History](https://llamitasspanish.com/famous-latinas-in-history): Profiles of 15 inspiring Latinas including Frida Kahlo and Gabriela Mistral
- [Chistes Para Niños: Simple Spanish Jokes for Kids](https://llamitasspanish.com/spanish-jokes-for-kids): Collection of Spanish jokes (chistes) for kids and family language practice
- [FabuLingua Review~ A Spanish Learning App for Kids](https://llamitasspanish.com/fabulingua-spanish-app-kids-review): Honest review of FabuLingua story-based Spanish learning app for kids
